acceptance: Identify exact failing run/attempt/head IDs for each incident and inspect its retained stderr/terminal-error/diagnostic. A generic absence detail exit code1 is not the cause; a successful first-head run or later rerun is not failing-before evidence. If the diagnostic is irretrievably absent, record exactly what is missing and capture an equivalent contemporary failure before choosing a code fix.

Fix only the identified failing layer. Reuse current bounded retry/backoff and provider substitution; do not mask unknown errors, weaken review, reset owner-only backoff, or add generic retries in place of diagnosis.

Document permitted exact-head manual workflow dispatch/rerun and existing backoff/budget guards in the current agent review protocol, clearly separating a plain supported rerun from an owner-only backoff reset.

Prove the identified cause fails before and passes after through a retained affected head or deterministic fake-service regression, and record a real exact-head verdict after repair. Keep runner queueing and host pin drift classified separately from reviewer process exit.

Recovery was by hand: gh run rerun of the verdict workflow, or amending the commit to force a new head. make oracle-backoff-reset needs an owner instruction comment, so workers could not use it. This added hours to landing. Root cause is unknown.
